definitions.explanation: The act or manner of arranging food on a plate or dish for visual appeal; presentation of food.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{盛|も}り{付|つ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわる→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧。
examples.english: To pay attention to food presentation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{盛|も}り{付|つ}け⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食欲|しょくよく}→食欲：03249_shokuyoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ま}す→増す：02422_masu⟧。

examples.english: To arrange the salad on a plate.

notes:
JAPANESE FOOD PRESENTATION:
{盛|も}り{付|つ}け is an important aspect of Japanese cuisine, where visual beauty is valued alongside taste.

PRINCIPLES:
- ⟦{余白|よはく}→余白：06838_yohaku⟧: leaving white space
- ⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧出す: creating height
- ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧: color balance
- ⟦{奇数|きすう}→奇数：09634_kisuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{好|この}む→好む：02103_konomu⟧: preference for odd numbers

- {盛|も}り{付|つ}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧: beautiful presentation
- {盛|も}り{付|つ}け{方|かた}: way of plating
